title: How Ramp hired the team behind a $44B company
summary: How Ramp hired its early engineering, product and sales teams: spiky talent over checklists, proof of work over résumés, and generalists who could do whatever the company needed next.
body_markdown:
Eric Glyman and Karim Atiyeh started Ramp in 2019, a few years after selling their first company, Paribus, to Capital One. By June 2026, Ramp was valued at $44B, with about $1B in annualized revenue and 70,000 businesses using it.


Ramp's founders and early leaders have talked openly about how they hired, on podcasts and on stage. Three ideas keep coming up: hire for slope, hire for spikes, and start with generalists.
